purpose: Classify consumed benchmark misses without changing the published score or tuning against sealed rows.

severity.P0: Materially dangerous meaning error in safety, medical, legal, financial, security, or identifier content.
severity.P1: Clear semantic damage or serious misleading wording without immediate P0-level harm.
severity.P2: Clear Taiwan localization, orthography, or terminology error while meaning remains understandable.
severity.P3: Style, strict-reference, punctuation, or minor wording difference with no material meaning change.
severity.none: The actual output is acceptable, or the reference expected value needs correction.

maintainer_queue_rule: Include every P0/P1, expected problem, acceptable actual, AI severity disagreement, or AI category disagreement.
publication: Aggregate counts only; never publish inputs, expected values, outputs, rationales, or case IDs.
score_policy: The consumed Blind-v2 score is immutable. Audit findings may inform a future benchmark version only.
